objective: Independently review the H-GGM-001 + EXP-GGM-001 generic-group simulability package with two non-originating review-xhigh sessions (Reviewer on test soundness and decidability, Red Team on the claim_tier_basis scale-independence argument), repair the unbound BATCH-004 archive receipts, and ledger-archive the result. tasks.title: Independently review the H-GGM-001 hypothesis and EXP-GGM-001 simulability-test specification

handoff.objective: Decide whether the frozen EXP-GGM-001 specification is sound enough to govern a valid execution of the simulability test, by attacking its control gate, its simulator-construction and witness-construction methods, its decidability, and its stated boundaries.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a SIMULABLE or NON-SIMULABLE verdict produced by this protocol would mean what H-GGM-001 claims it means, or whether the protocol's verdicts are artifacts of how the eight oracle specifications were written.
inputs: ledger/hypotheses/H-GGM-001.yaml (status specified; do not change it)
experiments/EXP-GGM-001/specification.yaml (status review_required, approved_by null; do not change it)
ledger/proposals/IDEA-20260726-004.yaml
knowledge/techniques/KN-TECH-005.md and knowledge/open-problems/KN-OPEN-005.md
AGENTS.md, docs/claims-and-verification.md, docs/evidence-and-reproducibility.md, docs/task-lifecycle.md
coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/batches/BATCH-006/batch.yaml, section review_package_binding
coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/batches/BATCH-004/reviews/TASK-20260726-003/review_report.yaml as the format precedent for snapshot_validation
constraints: Use a non-originating independent session. H-GGM-001 and EXP-GGM-001 were authored by the Coordinator session (hypothesis.proposed_by coordinator; specification.inference_receipt requested_policy coordinator-ultra-code, resolved_model_id glm-5p2, fallback_used true). The session that produced those records must not perform this review, and the report must attest non-origination explicitly.

Establish the review binding first: for each of ledger/hypotheses/H-GGM-001.yaml and experiments/EXP-GGM-001/specification.yaml, resolve the commit that currently supplies it, confirm it is clean at HEAD, compute its SHA-256 from Git object content, and record commit, path, and hash in a snapshot_validation block. If the binding cannot be established, stop and return a binding failure instead of a review verdict.

Attack the control gate first. The specification makes 4/4 correct control classification the precondition for trusting any augmented-oracle verdict. Decide whether the four controls (pure_generic, discrete_log, public_curve, encoding) actually discriminate a sound test from an unsound one, or whether a trivial classifier that keys on surface features of the written specification would also pass 4/4.

Attack the simulator-construction method: 'the test attempts to express the oracle's answer as a function of group-operation results and equality tests' with statically counted overhead. Decide whether this is an algorithm with a decidable outcome or an undecidable search dressed as one, and whether a failed search is distinguishable from a proof of non-simulability.

Attack the witness definition. Decide whether 'generic-model-indistinguishable encoding pair with divergent oracle answers' is precise enough to be checked by a third party, and whether verify_witness re-verification 'with independent code' is achievable given the same author writes both paths.

Attack the verdict's dependence on specification wording. H-GGM-001 interpretation_limits already concede that a jet oracle specified as 'return the eps-coefficient of P+Q' may receive a different verdict from one specified as 'return the derivative of the addition map'. Decide whether the four augmented-oracle specifications as frozen are the faithful ones, and whether the four expected_verdict fields in the specification bias the test toward confirming them.
Check decidability and the possible negative outcome: state whether the falsification criterion can actually be reached by an execution of this protocol.
Do not implement, execute, or run anything. Do not change the status of H-GGM-001, EXP-GGM-001, or any other record. Only the Coordinator may do that, and only after TASK-20260726-008.
Do not endorse or extend any crypto-scale, breakthrough, or universal-impossibility claim.
Record requested_policy review-xhigh, the resolved model id, reasoning effort, fallback_used, and equivalence_to_requested_policy_claimed false if a fallback is used.
deliverables: review_report.yaml with snapshot_validation, independence_attestation, runtime_receipt, control-gate review, simulator-construction review, witness review, specification-wording review, decidability review, claim-boundary review, blocking_objections, non_blocking_objections, valid_aspects, terminal_verdict of PASS or REVISE or FAIL, verdict_rationale, and exactly one recommended_next_action

adversarial_notes.md giving the strongest reconstruction of the case against the specification, including at least one concrete scenario in which this protocol returns SIMULABLE for an oracle that is not simulable, or NON-SIMULABLE for one that is
completion_gate: Both artifacts exist and bind the reviewed paths to a resolved commit and a computed SHA-256 per review_package_binding.
The report attests a non-originating independent session and names the originating session it is distinct from.
The control gate, simulator construction, witness construction, specification wording, and decidability are each addressed with an explicit finding.
The report returns exactly one terminal_verdict of PASS, REVISE, or FAIL, with every blocking objection carrying a concrete fix.
No record status was changed and no execution was authorized or performed.
Exactly one recommended_next_action is recorded.
handoff.return_format: Independent YAML review verdict plus Markdown adversarial reconstruction.

tasks.title: Red-team the EXP-GGM-001 claim_tier_basis scale-independence and closure argument

handoff.objective: Falsify the single most consequential assertion in the package: that a SIMULABLE verdict from EXP-GGM-001 is a scale-independent mathematical closure at exponent 1/2 rather than toy-tier evidence, and that a NON-SIMULABLE verdict is a meaningful non-generic signal.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether this package is entitled to assert a conclusion above the toy claim tier at all, and what the correct claim tier and scope of each verdict actually are.
inputs: experiments/EXP-GGM-001/specification.yaml, fields claim_tier_basis, analysis_methodology.scale_independence_note, success_criterion, alternative_outcome
ledger/hypotheses/H-GGM-001.yaml, fields statement, mechanism, assumptions, interpretation_limits
docs/claims-and-verification.md claim tiers and refutation artifacts
AGENTS.md rules 4, 7, and 12
knowledge/techniques/KN-TECH-005.md (Shoup / Corrigan-Gibbs-Kogan generic lower bound) and knowledge/open-problems/KN-OPEN-005.md
ledger/hypotheses/H-STR-002.yaml with EV-STR-002 and DEC-20260726-006, since the endomorphism-oracle verdict is claimed to contextualize the H-STR-002 block-structure advantage
constraints: Use a non-originating independent session, distinct from both the Coordinator session that authored H-GGM-001 and EXP-GGM-001 and the TASK-20260726-005 reviewer session.
Establish the same review binding as TASK-20260726-005: resolve the commit supplying each reviewed path, confirm it is clean at HEAD, and record its computed SHA-256.

Attack the tier escalation directly. The specification asserts that a SIMULABLE verdict is 'NOT limited to toy tier' and is a 'derivation-level closure at exponent 1/2'. Test whether an executed Python module that reports a verdict constitutes a derivation at all, and whether the escalation from proof_status empirical_only to derivation is earned by the artifacts the protocol actually produces.

Attack the transfer step: even granting an O(1) simulator for a specific oracle specification, state exactly what is and is not closed. Distinguish (a) that oracle specification, (b) the informal technique family it stands for, and (c) prime-field ECDLP. Name every gap.

Attack the overhead bound: decide whether a statically counted constant C <= 10 measured on 8-16 bit toy curves can support a claim of N-independence, and construct the concrete case where C appears constant at toy scale and is not.

Attack the asymmetry: a SIMULABLE verdict is claimed to close a candidate, while a NON-SIMULABLE verdict is explicitly not a breakthrough. State whether this asymmetry is principled or whether it makes the experiment unable to produce a costly negative for the program.
Produce falsification routes: for each of the four augmented oracles, the cheapest concrete check that would show the expected_verdict is wrong.
Do not implement, execute, or run anything, and do not change any record status.
Record requested_policy review-xhigh, the resolved model id, reasoning effort, fallback_used, and equivalence_to_requested_policy_claimed false if a fallback is used.
deliverables: objections.md ranking every objection to the claim_tier_basis and closure argument by severity, each with the exact specification or hypothesis text it targets

falsification_routes.yaml giving, per augmented oracle and per control, a concrete cheapest-check falsification route, plus an explicit recommended claim_tier and proof_status ceiling for any evidence record that a future execution of EXP-GGM-001 could support
completion_gate: Both artifacts exist and bind the reviewed paths to a resolved commit and a computed SHA-256.
The report attests a non-originating independent session distinct from both the authoring session and TASK-20260726-005.
An explicit recommended claim_tier and proof_status ceiling is stated for any future EXP-GGM-001 evidence record.
Every augmented oracle has at least one concrete falsification route.
No record status was changed and no execution was authorized or performed.
handoff.return_format: Markdown objection list plus YAML falsification routes with an explicit claim-tier ceiling recommendation.

tasks.title: Ledger-archive the BATCH-006 reviews, receipt repair, evidence, decision, and goal checkpoint

handoff.objective: Commit the two independent BATCH-006 review packages, the BATCH-004 receipt repair, the scoped evidence record, the Coordinator decision on EXP-GGM-001's fate, and the final goal checkpoint, as one isolated verified ledger archive.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the BATCH-006 reviews and the final campaign decision are durable and verifiable, and what the officially recorded disposition of EXP-GGM-001 and of GOAL-ECDLP-001 is.
inputs: the two exact TASK-20260726-005 review artifacts
the two exact TASK-20260726-006 red-team artifacts
the three exact TASK-20260726-007 BATCH-004 repair artifacts
coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/batches/BATCH-006/batch.yaml positive, negative, and inconclusive branches
templates/research-records.md evidence, decision, and goal schemas
constraints: Run alone. Stage only the declared archive and source artifact paths, and preserve unrelated dirty files.

Validate independence first: both producer reports must attest non-originating sessions distinct from each other and from the session that authored H-GGM-001 and EXP-GGM-001. If either attestation is absent, the archive stops and the reviews are not treated as independent evidence.
Validate the review binding: both reports must bind the reviewed paths to a resolved commit and a computed SHA-256. An unbound review is an evidence-integrity failure, not a verdict.

The evidence record EV-ECDLP-007 is theoretical review evidence over a design package. Its claim_tier and proof_status must not exceed what the TASK-20260726-006 falsification_routes.yaml ceiling allows, and it must not assert that any oracle is or is not simulable, because no execution occurred.

The decision DEC-20260726-008 must select exactly one branch from batch.yaml. Approving EXP-GGM-001 for a future separately budgeted execution is permitted; authorizing execution inside this campaign is not, because BATCH-006 exhausts campaign_budget.maximum_batches.

Change the status of H-GGM-001 or EXP-GGM-001 only in this task, only in the direction the two reviews support, and only with the transition named in DEC-20260726-008. A disagreement between the two reviews is inconclusive, not approval.
Fill knowledge_promotion. Promote a KN-FIND only on support or reject_scoped backed by replicated or strong evidence; otherwise record a concrete not_warranted reason.

Update the goal record in this same commit: append the BATCH-006 checkpoint with its exact task ids, both verdicts, evidence and decision ids, and claim boundary; set latest_verified_commit only to a commit whose verification is recorded in a committed receipt; and preserve exactly one next_action.
Evaluate pause_condition 1: BATCH-006 exhausts the six-batch budget. Set goal status to paused unless a committed completion criterion is met, and state which condition was applied.
Stop on any archive verification failure and record the failure rather than a research conclusion.
deliverables: ledger_commit_receipt.json with kind ledger, source_task_ids, record_ids, and the post-commit commit_sha, parent_sha, and complete path_sha256
ledger/evidence/EV-ECDLP-007.yaml scoped to a reviewed design package with no execution

The evidence record states plainly that no execution of EXP-GGM-001 occurred and asserts no oracle verdict.
The decision selects exactly one branch, cites the review and red-team ids, and fills knowledge_promotion.
The goal record carries the BATCH-006 checkpoint, the applied budget condition, and exactly one next_action.
The post-commit verifier accepts the commit for exact paths, parent, reachability, message ids, and every SHA-256.
